stone.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original seamless square base-color material texture for a low-poly isometric action RPG. Warm grimdark painterly fantasy; handmade broad shapes, muted earth palette, readable midtones, restrained contrast, no crushed blacks. Flat orthographic surface filling the whole square. Even diffuse neutral illumination: no baked lighting, shadows, highlights, perspective, vignette, border, objects, text or watermark. Seamless matching opposite edges. Material detail must read from a distant gameplay camera; avoid photorealistic micro-noise and busy decorative motifs. Warm gray weathered woodland stone: broad irregular mineral strata, understated charcoal fissures, sparse olive lichen and faint earthy staining. No cobblestone pattern.
